Class Test3ConcordantRandomWalk

java.lang.Object
concordanceExperiments.Test3ConcordantRandomWalk
public class Test3ConcordantRandomWalk extends Object
Experiment driver for the 3-concordant random-walk generator in ConcordanceExplorer.

The program initializes rankings, verifies 3-concordance, runs the edge-flip process, performs consistency and cycle diagnostics, and optionally exports a k-nearest-neighbor edge list to CSV for downstream rank-based linkage.

Example runs indicate high throughput (for example, hundreds of millions of flips at n = 1000 on suitable hardware).

WARNING: integer-overflow risks appear for larger n when expressions involving n^3 are evaluated with int arithmetic.

Author:
R. W. R. Darling

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Runs the end-to-end random-walk experiment and reports results to the logger.

      Workflow:

      1. Generate and optionally print random rank tables.
      2. Initialize a concordant ranking and verify 3-concordance.
      3. Run an edge-flip process for a random number of steps.
      4. Perform consistency checks and cycle diagnostics.
      5. Write the first k ordered neighbors per vertex to a CSV edge file.
      6. Estimate 4-cycle frequency from random 4-vertex samples.
      Parameters:
      args - not used
